name: DraftKings
description: DraftKings is a digital sports entertainment and gaming company operating a mobile/online sportsbook, an online casino (iGaming) product, and a legacy daily fantasy sports business, primarily in the United States with expansion into other regulated markets. It earns revenue as a net win margin on sports betting handle after paying out winning wagers and promotional credits, and as a net win margin on iGaming wagers, plus smaller media/other revenue. The company holds no physical casinos; it operates under 'skin'/market-access licenses (often via land-based casino partners) in each regulated US state.

founded.value: 2012 (by Jason Robins, Matt Kalish and Paul Liberman)

employees.note: 10-K human capital section describes 'over 5,500 employees located in thirteen countries'

businessLines.name: Sportsbook
businessLines.description: Online and mobile sports betting across regulated US states and select international jurisdictions.

businessLines.name: iGaming
businessLines.description: Online real-money casino games (slots, table games, live dealer) offered in states that have legalized iGaming alongside sports betting.

businessLines.name: Other (Daily Fantasy Sports & media)
businessLines.description: Legacy daily fantasy sports contests and other/media revenue, now a small minority of total revenue.
